hypotheses.metadata:
# Metadata for this hypothesis. Keep it current; the report prints it.
question = "Given the posterior at 00:11 and fuel exhaustion, where, when and how energetically did the aircraft reach the sea, under each explicitly weighted end-of-flight family (controlled glide, ditching, unpiloted spiral/phugoid, dive), with and without the 00:19 transmissions?"
# open | supported | not-supported | inconclusive
status = "open"
# One line, written when the question is answered, citing the run that answered it.
summary = ""
# Changes needed in the core (new hooks, new state fields). Leave empty if none.
# A hypothesis agent writes requests here and stops; it never edits core code.
core_requests = [
    "Zero-weight draws in the terminal stage: accept an empty Vec<Descent> from descend (and a -inf correction from takeover_time) as a child of weight zero, still counted as a child. A draw can lie outside the module's prior: a powered descent that would reach the sea only after exhaustion, or (with fuel) a path out of fuel before the hand-off. The module drops such descents and scales the rest by kept/drawn, which keeps the weights exact, but when none is kept it can only return nothing, and the runner stops ('returned no descent'). If every child of a parent has weight zero, the parent's prior support is empty: give it weight zero and report the lost hand-off weight.",
    "When fuel lands: per trajectory, the second (left) flame-out time or the fuel state implying it, the mass, and ideally the left/right fuel imbalance.",
]
hypotheses.name: end-of-flight
